name: 39601 · Brookhaven, MS
findings: ZIP 39601 (Brookhaven) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39601 (Brookhaven) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 39601 (Brookhaven) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 48% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 59% of all organizations here have no identified type.
